description: List the whole risk register (ordered by risk code): scores, treatment status and any acceptance (accepted_by, accepted_at, rationale, expiry, acceptance_state). Filter by status, level, category.

acceptance_state.description: Accepted risks only, by their approval: 'approved' (in force), 'expired' (past acceptance_expires_on) or 'unapproved' (accepted with no approval recorded)

category.description: Filter by catalog risk category code, e.g. 'AC' matches R-AC-N

risk_level.description: Filter by inherent risk level, banded by the org's risk profile

status.description: Filter by treatment status: identified, analysed, treating, treated, accepted or monitoring (sent as the platform's treatment_status)

name: scf_list_risks
